findings.evidence: Mathlib's `spectralNorm.normedField` is declared in the `variable ... [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]` section (SpectralNorm.lean lines 630 and 693ff), and the PR's lines 193–273 use no finite-dimensional result; `FiniteDimensional.proper` first uses finiteness at line 282.
findings.fix: State the normed-field/topology/valuative-relation definitions and their lemmas under `[Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]`; introduce `[Module.Finite K L]` only for `finiteExtension_locallyCompactSpace` and `finiteExtension_isNonarchimedeanLocalField`, deriving algebraicity there.
findings.issue: `[Module.Finite K L]` over-specializes every declaration through `finiteExtension_isValuativeTopology` (lines 193–273), although their proofs use only algebraicity.

summary: The spectral-norm construction and compatibility API are unnecessarily restricted to finite extensions; only local compactness and the final local-field theorem require finiteness.
